title: Kuromanta pyramid: documented red granite chambers and GPR scans
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Kuromanta pyramid: documented red granite chambers and GPR scans, about Jomon era; modern excavations at Japan (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Which is um it is a legitimate archaeologically documented man-made pyramid that has internal red granite reaction chambers. They GPR scanned it.

plain: Researcher Geoffrey Drumm, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says the Kuromanta pyramid in Akita, Japan is a properly documented, man-made pyramid. He says it has red granite chambers inside, which he calls reaction chambers, and that it was scanned with ground-penetrating radar, a tool that uses radio waves to see what lies beneath the surface. For Drumm, this backs his idea that pyramids were built to work like machines.
